description: This file handles authentication label resolution, including profile management, credential labeling, expiration formatting, and source referencing for auth profiles in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: resolveStoredCredentialLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for stored credentials, masking API keys or indicating references or missing credentials.

methods.name: formatExpirationLabel
methods.description: Formats expiration timestamps into human-readable labels, indicating if credentials are expired or valid.

methods.name: formatFlagsSuffix
methods.description: Creates a string suffix from an array of flags, for display purposes.

methods.name: resolveAuthLabel
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves an authentication label and source based on provider, configuration, and profile data.

methods.name: formatAuthLabel
methods.description: Formats the authentication label with its source if applicable.
